collection.description: A young naturalist observes a Great-Sail Leaffish in a reef channel, but another observer disputes its fin shape.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A young naturalist observes a Great-Sail Leaffish in a reef channel and believes its distinctive courtship display may distinguish it from other fish. Another observer disagrees about the fin shape.

choices.label: Sketch it from a safe distance
Keep a living specimen briefly for observation

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The drawing captures the Leaffish silhouette, but the great-sail fin detail is disputed; an apprentice marks the page "unconfirmed."

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The fish reveals details missed underwater; careful husbandry and release become part of the record, though handling stresses it.

text_only.reason: the fish is stressed, not a villager

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The record gains anatomical detail but the fish dies; villagers debate whether the knowledge justified the loss, especially if numbers are low.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: The fish disappears for days. When it returns, a different observer notes a variation that complicates the original classification.

text_only.reason: an animal, not a villager; no one vanishes
